tiers.name: Firm
tiers.blurb: Consistent in every account the author remembers. Not checked against a source here.

tiers.name: Reported
tiers.blurb: Widely reported, or it rests on what Davis himself said; details may differ between accounts. Reported does not mean doubted: it means the detail comes from reports that have not been checked here.

tiers.name: Uncertain
tiers.blurb: Recalled from memory and not confirmed. Treat as unverified.
